description: One window of one ESA WorldCover land cover map read by HTTP range requests from the public AWS bucket, server-side, around the T1-06 Copernicus GLO-30 probe window (PRD 5 row 12; 8.7 step 4; 15 architecture review: WorldCover COG paths). Raw observations only: no eligibility mask is applied, the CORS evidence is outputs/pilot/cors_check.json, and the G0 status is a human checkpoint (PRD 23.6).

field_notes.units: class codes; their names are the legend tag of the map file
field_notes.window: a window of at most max_window_pixels per side inside the T1-06 area, so it covers fraction_of_area_window of it, not all of it

open_g0_items: Whether the WorldCover COGs are CORS-readable from a browser (PRD 8.7 step 4) is recorded as header evidence in outputs/pilot/cors_check.json, not here
No snow, water or bare-ground eligibility mask is derived (PRD 5 row 12, D31)
The G0 status and the shipping mode are a human checkpoint (PRD 23.6)

range_read.sha256_note: the map was not downloaded whole, so its SHA-256 is unknown; local_sha256 is that of the fetched byte ranges held in local_path, at the positions listed in ranges

tile_choice.rule: the tile of the pinned release's tiling grid (esa_worldcover_grid.geojson, saved by fetch) whose 3 x 3 degree square holds the T1-06 window centre, west and south edges inclusive; the T1-06 window's geographic bounds must lie inside it, because the pilot reads one tile
tile_choice.url_rule: https://<bucket>.s3.<region>.amazonaws.com/<version>/<year>/map/ESA_WorldCover_10m_<year>_<version>_<tile>_Map.tif, the key layout the bucket lists under <version>/<year>/map/

WorldCover/esa-worldcover/v200/2021/map/.basis: a 512 x 512 pixel window read through 2 HTTP range requests (524288 of the 38079044 bytes; the map is not downloaded whole), header and window decoded and class pixels counted; not plotted, so the PRD 5 entry rule is not complete

window.rule: area_pixel_window holds every map pixel whose cell, as the COG's geotransform defines it, intersects the T1-06 window's geographic bounds. The read window takes at most max_window_pixels columns and rows of it: centred on the T1-06 centre's pixel (offset by half the window side, rounded down) and shifted, if needed, to stay inside area_pixel_window. fraction_of_area_window is the pixel count read over the pixel count of area_pixel_window

year_pin.reason: v200 (2021) is pinned: the bucket holds two releases, v100 (2020) and v200 (2021), and the pilot reads the later one. PRD 5 row 12 asks for one pinned year; the pin is a pilot choice. Neither year is the date of a radar acquisition (the Holuhraun UAVSAR scene of PRD 5 is from May 2015), so the map states land cover in 2021, not on any radar date
